title: Alerts
description: Everything about alerting: alerts firing now and for how long, history and statistics (noisiest, flapping, longest), and the health of each pipeline stage: Prometheus rules, vmalert (log rules), Alertmanager and Telegram delivery.

list.name: New image deployed
list.expr: (count by (name, image) (container_last_seen{name!="", image!=""}) unless count by (name, image) (container_last_seen{name!="", image!=""} offset 10m)) and on (name) (time() - container_start_time_seconds{name!=""} < 120)

panels.title: Health — is anything firing, and does alerting itself work

options.content: **Pipeline:** Prometheus rules (metrics) and vmalert (log rules) → **Alertmanager** (grouping, silences, inhibition) → **Telegram**. Grafana runs its own dead man's switch rules directly to Telegram, so they still fire when this pipeline is down. `Watchdog` must always be firing: if it is 0, alerts cannot reach you. Silence or inspect alerts in [Alertmanager](http://localhost:9093) · [vmalert](http://localhost:8880) · [Grafana alerting](/alerting/list).

panels.title: Critical firing
panels.description: Critical alerts firing now: loud Telegram message, repeated every hour.

panels.title: Warning firing
panels.description: Warnings firing now: silent Telegram message, repeated every 4 hours.

panels.title: Pending
panels.description: Condition is true but the rule's 'for' time has not passed yet: about to fire.

panels.title: Watchdog
panels.description: Always-firing alert proving the rule → Alertmanager path works. BROKEN = alerts are not being evaluated.

panels.title: Telegram failures (1h)
panels.description: Messages Alertmanager failed to deliver. Check the bot token, chat id and network.

panels.title: Active silences
panels.description: Silences hiding alerts right now. Forgotten silences hide real problems.

panels.title: Rule failures (15m)
panels.description: Rule evaluations that errored (bad query, datasource down) in Prometheus and vmalert. A failing rule never fires.

panels.title: Notifications dropped (1h)
panels.description: Alerts Prometheus or vmalert could not hand to Alertmanager.

panels.title: Firing now
panels.description: Every firing alert with its labels and how long it has been firing. Sorted by duration. Use the column filters to narrow down. Empty: Nothing firing

targets.expr: (time() - ALERTS_FOR_STATE{alertname=~"$alertname", severity=~"$severity", alertname!="Watchdog"}) and ignoring (alertstate) ALERTS{alertstate="firing", alertname=~"$alertname", severity=~"$severity", alertname!="Watchdog"}

panels.title: Alert timeline
panels.description: When each alert was firing over the selected range. Many short blocks = flapping.

targets.expr: max by (alertname, severity) (ALERTS{alertstate="firing", alertname=~"$alertname", severity=~"$severity", alertname!="Watchdog"})

panels.title: Alert statistics (selected range)
panels.description: Per alert over the selected range: total firing minutes (all series), times it started firing, and how many different targets it hit. Many starts with few minutes = flapping: raise 'for' or the threshold.

targets.expr: sum by (alertname, severity) (count_over_time(ALERTS{alertstate="firing", alertname=~"$alertname", severity=~"$severity", alertname!="Watchdog"}[$__range:1m]))

count by (alertname, severity) (max by (alertname, severity, instance, name, job, datname, service) (max_over_time(ALERTS{alertstate="firing", alertname=~"$alertname", severity=~"$severity", alertname!="Watchdog"}[$__range:1m])))

panels.title: Firing by severity
panels.description: Share of firing alerts by severity.

panels.title: Firing by job
panels.description: Which part of the stack the firing alerts come from (empty job = log rules from vmalert).

panels.title: Firing alerts over time
panels.description: Number of firing alerts by severity.

panels.title: Top 10 by firing time
panels.description: Alerts that were firing the longest in the selected range.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (alertname) (count_over_time(ALERTS{alertstate="firing", alertname=~"$alertname", severity=~"$severity", alertname!="Watchdog"}[$__range:1m])))

panels.title: Alertmanager
panels.description: Scrape status of Alertmanager.

panels.title: Config reload
panels.description: Last config reload. FAILED = Alertmanager keeps the old config; check its logs.

panels.title: Alerts in Alertmanager
panels.description: Alerts Alertmanager currently holds as active.

panels.title: Suppressed
panels.description: Alerts hidden by a silence or an inhibition rule (e.g. warnings hidden while the matching critical fires).

panels.title: Aggregation groups
panels.description: Distinct groups (by group_by labels). One group = one Telegram message thread.

panels.title: Notifications by integration
panels.description: Messages per minute sent and failed, per receiver integration.

panels.title: Delivery latency (p50 / p95 / p99)
panels.description: Time Alertmanager needs to deliver a message to Telegram.

panels.title: Alerts received
panels.description: Alert updates received per minute from Prometheus and vmalert. Senders resend firing alerts regularly, so this is never 0 while anything fires.

panels.title: Alerts by state
panels.description: active vs suppressed (silenced/inhibited) vs unprocessed.

panels.title: Silences
panels.description: Silences by state. Expired ones are kept for a while, then garbage-collected.

panels.title: Suppressed notifications
panels.description: Notifications not sent because of a silence, inhibition or the maintenance window (time_intervals).

panels.title: Rule group evaluation time vs interval
panels.description: How much of its interval each group needs. Near 100% = the group cannot keep up and starts missing evaluations.

panels.title: Evaluation failures & missed iterations
panels.description: Should be 0. Failures = broken query; missed = group too slow.

panels.title: Rule groups
panels.description: Every rule group loaded by Prometheus (file;group).

panels.title: Prometheus → Alertmanager
panels.description: Alert notifications Prometheus hands to Alertmanager. Errors/dropped > 0 = Alertmanager unreachable.

panels.title: Log alerts firing / pending
panels.description: Alerts from vmalert's LogsQL rules (vmalert/rules/*.yml).

panels.title: Rule executions & errors
panels.description: Errors = the LogsQL query failed (syntax, VictoriaLogs down).

panels.title: Group iteration time vs interval
panels.description: p99 evaluation time as a share of the interval.

panels.title: Remote write (alert state → VictoriaMetrics)
panels.description: vmalert stores ALERTS series in VictoriaMetrics; errors here mean log alerts vanish from this dashboard.

panels.title: vmalert config
panels.description: Last rule file reload.

panels.title: Errors by component
panels.description: Warnings and errors logged by the alerting components.

targets.expr: service:~"alertmanager|vmalert|prometheus|grafana" level:(error OR fatal OR panic OR warn) | stats by (service, level) count()

panels.title: Alerting component logs
panels.description: Recent warnings and errors: failed notifications, bad rules, config reload problems.

targets.expr: service:~"alertmanager|vmalert|prometheus" level:(error OR fatal OR panic OR warn) | sort by (_time desc) | limit 300
